subject.title: fix: align gateway agent timeout default

question: Should OpenClaw accept changing omitted gateway `openclaw agent` timeouts from the shipped hidden 600-second cap to server-owned/runtime default behavior after the PR is rebased?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well-proven, but it deliberately changes shipped fallback behavior for existing CLI/gateway users and the PR is now conflicted against current main.

options.title: Accept Server-Owned Omitted Timeouts
options.body: Rebase and land the PR so explicit `--timeout` or config becomes the supported shorter-cap path.

options.title: Keep The Hidden 600s Cap
options.body: Close or narrow this PR if maintainers decide the gateway CLI should preserve the shipped implicit 600-second fallback.

options.title: Require Extra Upgrade Visibility
options.body: Ask for explicit release-note or PR-body wording before merge so operators know omitted gateway CLI calls may run longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Server-Owned Omitted Timeouts
recommendation.body: Rebase and land the PR so explicit `--timeout` or config becomes the supported shorter-cap path.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` introduced and recently maintained the gateway-backed agent CLI path where the compatibility decision lands.
